name: Eligible Security 5
definition: Provides details of the eligible securities as defined in the collateral reference data.

SecurityIdentification.name: Security Identification
SecurityIdentification.definition: Identification of a security by an ISIN.

CollateralisationCurrency.name: Collateralisation Currency
CollateralisationCurrency.definition: Currency which may be processed by the system. A system may process transactions in a single currency or in multiple currencies.

EligibilitySetProfile.name: Eligibility Set Profile
EligibilitySetProfile.definition: Number identifying the collateral eligibility set profile of the counterparty.

PartyIdentification.name: Party Identification
PartyIdentification.definition: Identifies the party for which the eligible security is defined.
